components.name: EntityToken

TWO interaction styles, never combined: 'pill' (default) rests as a subtle pill and changes color on hover/focus; 'link' rests as accent ink + underline and BECOMES a pill with the underline removed on hover/focus. Accessible name via openLabel (default 'Open {kind} {label}') plus a title tooltip that should carry the FULL value whenever the label is truncated (long paths, SHAs, URLs); the 13px stroke kind icon is aria-hidden.

components.description: Primitive 4 (spec §4): the ten canonical execution statuses as a filled pill — Draft, Running, Waiting for input, Waiting approval, Needs review, Blocked, Completed, Partial, Failed, Cancelled. Sans (NEVER mono) 11–12px weight 600; ALWAYS icon + label + tone together so color never carries the meaning alone. Each tone renders a filled treatment — tinted fill + tone border + tone ink via the --kx-tech-status-* tokens (success reads the AA accent ink; warning/danger share the tuned amber family with the firm × telling them apart; neutral reads the AA muted ink). Running pulses a live dot that prefers-reduced-motion kills while keeping it visible. Non-clickable by default; an onClick upgrades the pill to real <button> semantics with a visible focus ring; an optional label override keeps tone + glyph (e.g. completed → 'Answered').

propDocs.status: required, TechStatus — one of the ten canonical keys (TECH_STATUSES)
propDocs.onClick: optional, () => void — upgrades the pill to a <button> with hover edge + focus ring
propDocs.label: optional, string — overrides the canonical label while keeping tone + glyph

components.fixtureRef: variant grid: all ten canonical badges side by side (Running pulses its dot) | one Needs review badge with onClick — real button semantics
components.adoptionNotes: Pure; the status set itself is canonical (TECH_STATUSES + TECH_STATUS_LABELS) — settled-state readings go through the label override, never a new status key. RESPONSIVE: pills keep white-space nowrap and wrap as whole units with gap on narrow columns.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.description: Primitive 5 (spec §5): the multiline counterpart of InlineCode — a header (mono muted meta + a Copy button with brief 'Copied' feedback via the shared stream clipboard helper) over a focusable <pre><code> body (mono 12–13px, lh 1.55) that scrolls horizontally without shrinking the font. Line numbers appear by default past 5 lines (overridable); code longer than 12 lines starts collapsed showing the first 10 behind a 'Show full code' toggle (aria-expanded). An optional muted footer line carries source/execution context, and a per-line class hook enables diff-style tinting on tool-evidence output.

propDocs.code: required, string — the code; a trailing newline is ignored
propDocs.meta: optional, string — header meta: a language or a file path (e.g. 'sql' or 'config/sync.yaml')
propDocs.lineNumbers: optional, boolean — overrides the >5-line default: true = always numbered, false = never
propDocs.lineClassName: optional, (line: string) => string | undefined — per-line class hook (e.g. diff +/- tinting)
propDocs.footer: optional, ReactNode — muted footer line for source/execution context

components.fixtureRef: variant grid: a 4-line SQL query (under the line-number gate, no numbers) | a 16-line YAML config collapsed to 10 numbered lines with Show full code + Copy interactive | the SQL again with a muted 'Executed 09:41 · 3 rows returned' footer
